followup: For any initial candidate-vs-immediate-baseline lane with CI upper < 1, select its operation and run one separate 20-block follow-up with all three modes. Retain all blocks/errors/negatives; no pooling and no recursive follow-up.
adoption: Require exact baseline outputs and validation gates; reject if no meaningful intended improvement or clear reproduced new regression outweighs gain. Strict lane win additionally requires CI lower > 1 and every block faster.
scope: One development corpus, two fixed unfiltered slices on one host; no sealed holdout or toolkit-wide superiority; previous unresolved negatives remain unresolved unless separately measured against original baseline.
